subject: ShellPkg/Cls: Factorize color parsing
reasons: Refactoring in a single file (Cls.c): introduces GetClsColorIndex() helper and lookup tables to replace two large switch statements for color mapping
Replacing a switch statement with a table lookup + helper function call is not expressible as a general SmPL transformation, especially when the switch has many unique cases
One-off structural change specific to this command's color-handling logic; no similar pattern in neighboring commits or across the codebase
